scope: DNS detail grouped layout, copy feedback, and list-to-detail return continuity

changes: DNS basic information, error, and answer rows use the grouped activity-detail surface and Flutter-aligned row geometry.
Missing initiator/upstream/answer sections remain hidden; copy success and clipboard failure feedback remain covered.
DNS list detail uses a 100-row fixture, opens row 50, scrolls detail content, sends system Back, and verifies the original row position is preserved.

instrumentedTests.command: adb -s 31936bb6 shell am instrument -w -r -e class DnsDetailsInstrumentedTest,ObservationDetailsInstrumentedTest,ConnectionsInstrumentedTest#connectionsRowOpensDetailsAndClosesWithoutChangingList -e kclashCapturePng true -e kclashCapturePngChunks true com.lonnnnnng.flclash.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

results.focus: dark/light success/error states, expanded sheet content, answer/error copy success and failure
DNS row geometry and return position, activity-list behaviors and regressions
home connection-card detail retains its existing compact layout

validatedScreenshotManifest.validation: All chunk indices, decoded PNG dimensions, byte lengths, and SHA-256 values matched the instrumentation metadata.

visualEvidence.review: Dark/light success and error layouts were visually inspected. Stable partial-state hashes are test-gated. Expanded-state screenshots are retained for manual review; repeated captures differed in full-window pixels, so expanded-state behavior is gated by visible content, geometry, and copy assertions instead of a brittle full-window hash. The cause of those pixel differences is not established.

limits: This uses deterministic Compose fixtures and does not exercise live MainActivity DNS data, Hilt, the core bridge, VPN, or production Room state.
Flutter source layout was checked; this batch did not run a live Flutter side-by-side comparison.
Other subpages and continuous transitions remain open. Menu discarded producer and GPU/fence attribution remain unresolved; no performance gain is claimed.
